pr-boscombe-1.question: Who killed Charles McCarthy at Boscombe Pool?
pr-boscombe-1.truth: John Turner of the Hall (once 'Black Jack of Ballarat') killed Charles McCarthy; James McCarthy is innocent.
reveal_quotes: Is a tall man, left-handed, limps with the right leg
It was an Indian cigar

Black Jack of Ballarat was the name I went under
I did it, Mr. Holmes.
pr-boscombe-1.rationale: Cut before Holmes shows Lestrade the stone ('The murder was done with it') and describes the murderer (tall, left-handed, lame, grey cloak); everything before is the inquest narrative, the Turner family introduction and the site visit. The Cooee/Ballarat deduction, the confession and the name follow.

pr-silver-1.question: Who killed John Straker?
pr-silver-1.truth: The horse Silver Blaze killed John Straker, in self-defence, when Straker tried to nick its tendon; Fitzroy Simpson is not the culprit.
reveal_quotes: The real murderer is standing immediately behind you.
Yes, the horse. And it may lessen his guilt if I say that it was done in self-defence
the steel shoe had struck Straker full on the forehead
pr-silver-1.rationale: Cut before the Wessex Cup scene in which Holmes says the real murderer is the horse; Holmes's earlier hints (the dog in the night-time, the lame sheep) are clues, not statements of the solution.
